[PolyAI](https://www.linkedin.com/company/polyai/) , a leader in conversational AI software, has chosen [British Land](https://www.linkedin.com/company/british-land/) ‘s Paddington Central campus as the location for their new headquarters. excerpts: 08\.06.2026 New London HQ for PolyAI by Motive calls on playfulness and connectivity. basis.reasoning: A report on PolyAI’s move explicitly calls Paddington Central its new headquarters, and a second report identifies the new London headquarters in Paddington. Other PolyAI office locations are not treated as HQ.
